# Lab 6.7: Search Indexes & the SEARCH Function

## What We Are Going to Do
Create a search index on a log table and use the SEARCH function to find tokens across all columns.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Create a log-style table.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE TABLE lab06.app_logs AS
SELECT
  created_at AS ts,
  CONCAT('user=', CAST(user_id AS STRING), ' event=', event_type, ' uri=', uri,
         ' browser=', browser, ' ip=', ip_address) AS message,
  session_id
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.events`;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] Create the search index.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE SEARCH INDEX logs_idx ON lab06.app_logs(ALL COLUMNS);</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] Check index coverage.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT index_name, index_status, coverage_percentage, total_logical_bytes, total_storage_bytes
FROM lab06.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SEARCH_INDEXES;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Indexes are built in the background. On tables under **10 GB** the index is not populated, but `SEARCH` still works by scanning.

4. **[SQL] Search for a token.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT ts, message
FROM lab06.app_logs
WHERE SEARCH(app_logs, '`event=purchase`')
LIMIT 20;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab06.app_logs
WHERE SEARCH(message, 'Firefox');</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **[Console] Check whether the index was used.** Open **Job information → Index usage mode**. On a large table it shows **FULLY_USED**.

6. **[CLI] Drop the index when done.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq query --use_legacy_sql=false 'DROP SEARCH INDEX logs_idx ON lab06.app_logs'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| `SEARCH` | Finds tokens in one or all columns |
| Index | Built in the background |
| Small tables | Index not populated under 10 GB |
| Index usage | Shown in job information |
